recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, oval-framed graphic emblem featuring stylized, interlocking bubble-style typography and a central musical note icon, all rendered with a vibrant, multi-directional airbrushed gradient against a soft, textured pastel background.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography follows the curvature of the outer oval frame.
Central musical note icon is integrated into a wave-like negative space within the oval.
Gradient flow transitions from pink to blue to gold across all graphic elements.
Star motifs act as terminal points for the framing strokes.
coreInvariants: Interlocking 'O' characters in the lower text arc
Five-pointed stars at the ends of the flourish lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized emblem occupying 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central musical note icon within the blue circular field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion starting from the top text, following the oval frame down to the bottom text, and returning to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced spacing between the text arcs and the central icon, with a distinct wave-like cutout in the center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue to magenta gradient for the primary graphic shapes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale yellow and peach for the textured background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright pink and cyan highlights within the gradient.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the emblem contrasting with low-value, high-brightness pastel background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a spectrum of cyan, magenta, and yellow

letterConstructionRules: Curved baselines following the oval path
Interlocking circular forms for repeating 'O' characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'D' feature extended flourishes that merge into the oval frame.
The 'V' has a sharp, angled start that transitions into the curve.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom typeface used for both arcs to maintain unity.
graphicDevices: Stylized musical note with star trails

candidateDirections.reason: Necessary to achieve the specific interlocking and arcing behavior.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a soft, grainy background with a subtle horizontal gradient of pale yellow, peach, and light green. In the center, place a large blue-to-purple gradient oval containing a white wave-like cutout and a stylized musical note icon with three stars.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom bold, rounded uppercase lettering in two arcs (top and bottom) following the oval's perimeter. Apply a pink-to-blue-to-gold airbrushed gradient to the text and the double-lined oval frame. Ensure the 'S' and 'D' at the top and the 'V' and 'D' at the bottom end in small five-pointed stars.

verificationChecks: Text follows the oval curve perfectly.
Stars are present at the ends of the flourish lines.
Background has a visible paper-like texture.

adjustableVariables: Number of stars on the musical note
mustRedesign: Exact star placement on the note
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gradient flows consistently across the frame and text.
Verify the background texture doesn't overpower the central graphic.
Confirm the star terminals are sharp and distinct.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Geometric Rounded Typography] + [Oval Path Alignment] + [Airbrush Rainbow Gradient] + [Star Flourishes] + [Textured Pastel Background].
